name: The Whispering Windwoven Library
description: A library woven from translucent fabrics that capture whispers of the wind, storing them as floating script‑like ribbons, creating a quiet sanctuary of stored sounds.
prompt: A delicate Whispering Windwoven Library: shelves made of translucent fabric that capture wind whispers as floating ethereal ribbons, soft natural light filtering through, serene reading nook, hyperrealistic, dreamy ambience.
caption: Enter the Whispering Windwoven Library—where every breath becomes a story stored in threads 🪡📚.
